sheet.title: Rules
items: $a<b,\ k<0\Rightarrow ka>kb$ and $\frac ak>\frac bk$ (reverse the sign)

sheet.title: Number line and intervals
items: On the number line: open circle for $<,>$; filled circle for $\le,\ge$

sheet.title: JEE: wavy-curve method
items: Make every factor $(x-a)$ with a positive coefficient of $x$
Mark the critical points; the sign is $+$ on the far right and alternates

formulas: Test a point (often $(0,0))$ to choose the half-plane
System: the solution region is the common region of all half-planes
$\frac{p(x)}{q(x)}>0:$ mark the zeros of $p, q$ and test the sign in each interval

use: Test a point (often $(0,0))$ to choose the half-plane

use: System: the solution region is the common region of all half-planes

use: $\frac{p(x)}{q(x)}>0:$ mark the zeros of $p, q$ and test the sign in each interval

use: $\frac{p(x)}{q(x)}>0:$ mark the zeros of $p, q$ and test the sign in each interval

lessons.title: The wavy-curve method (JEE)
formulas: Write the inequality as $\frac{(x-a_1)(x-a_2)\cdots}{(x-b_1)\cdots}\ \gtrless\ 0$ with each coefficient of $x$ positive
Put the critical points on the number line. The sign is $+$ to the right of the largest point
The sign changes at each point with an odd power and does not change at a point with an even power
Zeros of the numerator are included for $\ge$ or $\le$. Zeros of the denominator are never included

examples.question: Solve $(x-1)(x-3)<0$.
steps: Signs from the right: $+$ for $x>3$, $-$ for $1<x<3$, $+$ for $x<1$
reasoning: Each factor is $0$ at one point. These points cut the line into parts.
For a big $x$, both factors are positive. Each time we cross a point, one factor changes sign.
"$<0$" means the negative part.

examples.question: Solve $(x+2)(x-1)(x-4)\ge0$.
steps: Take the $+$ parts and include the points
reasoning: Put them in order on the number line.
"$\ge$" includes the zeros of the factors.

examples.question: Solve $\frac{x^2-4}{x-1}>0$.
steps: Signs from the right: $+$ on $(2,\infty)$, $-$ on $(1,2)$, $+$ on $(-2,1)$, $-$ on $(-\infty,-2)$

examples.question: Solve $(x-1)^2(x-3)<0$.
steps: Right of $3$: $+$. Between $1$ and $3$: $-$. Left of $1$: still $-$, because the sign does not change at an even power

examples.question: Solve $\frac{(2-x)(x+5)}{x-3}\ge0$.
steps: Make the coefficient positive: $\frac{(x-2)(x+5)}{x-3}\le0$ (the sign of the inequality turns)
Critical points: $-5, 2, 3$. Signs from the right: $+,\ -,\ +,\ -$
Take the $-$ parts. Include $-5$ and $2$, exclude $3$
examples.type: JEE · change the sign of a factor

examples.question: Solve $\frac1{x-1}\ge\frac2{x+1}$.
steps: Signs from the right: $+,\ -,\ +,\ -$. Take the $-$ parts

sheet.title: JEE: distribution and derangements

formulas: $n$ identical objects into $r$ different boxes (a box may be empty): ${}^{n+r-1}C_{r-1}$

reasoning: The chocolates are identical. Only the number that each child gets is important.
The first part goes to child 1, the second part to child 2 and the third part to child 3. A bar at the end gives that child $0$.

reasoning: This makes the condition "at least one" true at once.

The bars must go in the $4$ gaps between the $5$ stars, so no part is empty.
